pressure_regulation: Built-in PRS-45 stem regulates nozzle pressure to 45 psi for inlet pressures from 50 to 70 psi; below 50 psi, pressure loss does not exceed 6 psi.
compatibility_notes: Combines the Seal-A-Matic check valve with PRS-45 and is designed to maximize rotary-nozzle performance.
notes: 6 inch pop-up height and 9 3/8 inch body height. The SAM check valve holds up to 14 feet of head. PRS models are WaterSense certified. The spray body has no independent nozzle performance table.
